main_body: Pink cherry-blossom canopy (rows 0-31) on a short brown trunk with a small grass patch
top_band: none: column x=15 starts with dark plum rows 1-11 (L 59-89), then a light pink patch at rows 12-13 and mid/light pink down to row 31. No consistent lighter horizontal band sits above a front face.
evidence: The canopy is one lumpy blob. The lightest pink is in the middle and lower right, not on a top surface. The top of the crown is dark, so no top surface reads. There is no step marking a front edge, and no eave shadow beyond the canopy's own dark pockets. The canopy shows no horizontal top over a vertical face, and the trunk is a plain vertical shaft. It reads as a front-facing silhouette rather than the 3/4 contract, so it fails when in doubt.

style.evidence: The pink canopy has about 5 lightness steps with a plum outline tinted to the material (0% neutral edge pixels), and no 5x5 flat fills. It has only 11 distinct colours and a median of 5 per tile, against 108-109 per tile and 427-567 colours for the references. The leaf clumping is coarse, with large smooth patches of one tone, and the trunk and grass are simple. Next to the references it looks much thinner and flatter.
